notes: TypeScript/React storefront. Six required planted bugs, one optional, three decoys, one explicit state machine.

expected.title: Four independent loading/error/success/retry flags; error path never clears isLoading
Profile fetch has no abort or staleness guard; old userId response overwrites new
Order status is a raw string written from many functions; refunded/shipped orders can be reopened to pending
Order marked paid and tracked before the charge; charge failure is swallowed
localStorage draft cast to CheckoutDraft without validation; unknown step crashes stepTitle
401 handled three different ways in three modules
Notification poller has no stop path and keeps polling after logout
No in-flight guard or idempotency key on submitOrder; a double click charges twice
expected.source: Not planted. Found by an agent during an eval run and confirmed by hand.

decoys.why: Independent UI toggles; every combination is valid.
Discriminated union plus AbortController with cleanup. This is the correct pattern.
Explicit transition table with a guard that throws on illegal moves.
